description.text: Chinese language courses are divided into three levels: elementary, intermediate and advanced. Each level is subdivided into 2-3 sub-level classes. Students need to take placement test (written test and oral test) to decide which level of class they will be in. Each student is sure to find a class suitable for him or her at Tianjin Foreign Studies University.

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Language Course at Tianjin Foreign Studies University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1861 USD/per year ￥ 13400 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. A scanned copy of the Passport Information Page. For Spring semester, applicants shall submit a clear scanned copy of the passport that will not expire on or before April 1, 2024, and October 1, 2024 for Autumn Semester. 2. Foreigner Physical Examination Form 3. Certificate of Non-Criminal Record 4. A deposit certificate of more than 20000 RMB issued by the bank from the applicant or the economic guarantor.

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be 18-60 years old, non-Chinese citizens. 2. Applicants should be physically and mentally healthy, and abide by Chinese laws and the rules and regulations of Tianjin Foreign Studies University
